modules.name: TETRA Four-channel function generator
modules.description: 4 channel function generator: envelope (AD, AHR), cycling function, burst and LFO with random vacillator mode, channels linked in a ring.

modules.name: TETRA X End-of-stage expander
modules.description: Expander for TETRA: end of rise and end of fall gates for each channel. Place directly to the right of TETRA.

modules.name: PLINK Modal percussion voice
modules.description: Physical model percussion voice: mallet and noise exciter striking a modal string, beam, marimba bar, drum, membrane or plate. Preset step kits, morph and randomize.
